主要内容: On March 26, 2015, Matt Billington was appointed President and CEO of SouthCorp Capital, Inc., while Joseph Wade resigned from his position as Board of Director and CEO. Wade's resignation was to allow him to focus on consulting activities for WB Partners' clients, while Billington would concentrate on commercial and income-producing properties for SouthCorp Capital. Wade will remain as Director of Operations. This change in leadership marks a strategic shift in the company's direction, focusing on real estate development and management.
